mapper.sql: profiles AS ( SELECT genetic_profile.genetic_profile_id AS id, genetic_profile.stable_id AS stable_id, genetic_profile.genetic_alteration_type AS alteration_type, cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS study_id FROM genetic_profile INNER JOIN cancer_study ON cancer_study.cancer_study_id = genetic_profile.cancer_study_id WHERE genetic_profile.stable_id IN #{item} )

SELECT nullIf(gene_panel.stable_id, '') AS "genePanelId", s.sample_stable_id AS "sampleId", s.patient_stable_id AS "patientId", p.study_id AS "studyId", p.stable_id AS "molecularProfileId", ( sample_profile.genetic_profile_id != 0 OR ( p.alteration_type = 'MUTATION_EXTENDED' AND s.internal_id IN ( SELECT sample_list_list.sample_id FROM sample_list_list INNER JOIN sample_list ON sample_list.list_id = sample_list_list.list_id WHERE sample_list.stable_id IN (SELECT concat(study_id, '_sequenced') FROM profiles) ) ) ) AS "profiled"
FROM sample_derived s INNER JOIN profiles p ON p.study_id = s.cancer_study_identifier
LEFT JOIN sample_profile ON sample_profile.genetic_profile_id = p.id AND sample_profile.sample_id = s.internal_id LEFT JOIN gene_panel ON sample_profile.panel_id = gene_panel.internal_id
